title: Warm orange and bacon breakfast salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain staple: potatoes, eggs, bacon, oranges, Dijon mustard, olive oil, watercress and spring onions.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at Tesco or any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, a frying pan and a bowl, and the techniques are simple boiling, frying and peeling.

works.reason: The quantities suit four, a 7-minute egg and par-boiled then fried potatoes are sound, and the orange juice, mustard and oil dressing is well balanced; peeling the eggs is a gap any cook would fill.

honest_times.reason: Cubing, orange prep and frying the bacon and potatoes fit in roughly 20 active minutes, with the 10-minute boil inside the 15-minute cook time, so 35 minutes overall is believable.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Oranges are central to both the salad and the dressing, and a warm salad suits a late March morning.

plain_voice.reason: Short, clear British English steps with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, eggs, bacon, fruit and greens make a filling, balanced breakfast a family would happily eat.
